# IgnisControl — AI Wildfire Prediction System

A full-stack web application for wildfire risk modeling: upload tabular (CSV) or image datasets, preprocess them, train scikit-learn classification models (Random Forest, SVM, Neural Network, and more), run risk predictions, and explore live satellite fire detections, fire-spread simulations, and resource-prioritization recommendations — all from a clean dark-themed dashboard.

The system pairs a **React + Vite** frontend with an **Express** API that shells out to **Python (scikit-learn)** for every machine-learning job. Data is stored in **MySQL** through **Drizzle ORM**.

---

## Features

**End-to-end ML workflow (no Jupyter needed)**

- Upload **CSV datasets** (paste or batch-upload multiple at once) or **image datasets** (drag-and-drop, per-image class labels), or **combined** CSV + image datasets.
- One-click **"Create fire-risk labels"** on a CSV that contains an `area` column — it derives a binary `fire_risk` label (`1` when `area > 0`).
- **Preprocess** CSV datasets from the UI: missing-value handling, outlier capping/removal (IQR or Z-score), categorical encoding (label/one-hot), feature scaling (standard/min-max/robust), and class balancing (SMOTE). Every run produces a **proof report** (before/after shapes, column stats) so you can audit the transformation.
- **Train** one or several models in parallel on a chosen target column with selectable feature columns and test-split size. A data-driven **configuration suggestion** panel recommends a model name, algorithm, split size, target, and features based on the dataset.
- **Run predictions** with a trained model against any compatible dataset; results include per-row risk, a high-risk count, and a risk summary.
- Inspect **model quality** in depth: accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC/AUC curve, confusion matrix, and feature-importance charts.
- Image models train on locally extracted image features (color histograms, spatial statistics, fire-specific color ratios) — no external downloads required.

**Geospatial & decision-support tools**

- **Live Fires map** — near-real-time active-fire detections from **NASA FIRMS** (VIIRS & MODIS) with risk classification based on Fire Radiative Power (FRP) and detection confidence, filterable by time window, satellite, and risk level.
- **Fire Spread simulator** — click ignition points on a map, set wind/temperature/humidity/terrain/fuel parameters, and get projected spread perimeters over 1–72 hours, plus fire-behavior summaries. Save/load scenarios and compare them side by side.
- **Resource Prioritization** — ranks fire detections by urgency and recommends allocation of firefighting resources.
- **Dashboard** — aggregate stats: datasets/models/predictions counts, best model accuracy, high-risk zones detected, recent activity, and algorithm breakdown.

```
│  Drizzle ORM + mysql2                     Python ML engine        │

│                                             prioritize            │
```

```bash
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev

```
```bash
pnpm run offline
```

```bash
PORT=8080 pnpm run offline
```

```bat
start.cmd
```

```bash
cp .env.example .env    # Linux / macOS
copy .env.example .env  # Windows
```

```bash

PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3.11 pnpm run offline

set PYTHON_PATH=C:\Python311\python.exe && pnpm run offline
```

```bash
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen
```
```bash
pnpm dev                    # Dev mode, hot reload (API :3001 + web :5173)
pnpm run offline            # Build everything + start on a single port (:3000)
pnpm typecheck              # Type-check all packages
```
```bash
# Frontend only
pnpm --filter @workspace/wildfire-app run dev       # Vite dev server (:5173)
```
